inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped order report filters active rows by status and projects both JSON_ARRAYAGG of item identifiers and JSON_OBJECTAGG of item-to-order mappings per user.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an active-order report. Each customer group collects goods IDs in deterministic order and maps each goods ID to its order reference; inactive orders and customers with no active orders are excluded. The source data, identifiers, and values are newly authored.

fixture_notes: Customer 3101 has two active orders and one inactive order; customer 3102 has two active orders; customer 3103 has only an inactive order and is excluded. Goods IDs are unique per customer, so JSON_OBJECTAGG duplicate-key behavior is not part of this contract.
determinism_notes: Primary keys, customer IDs, goods IDs, order references, statuses, aggregate ordering, grouping, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE aggregate_orders (order_id INT PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INT NOT NULL, goods_id INT NOT NULL, order_ref VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, status TINYINT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT customer_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG(goods_id ORDER BY goods_id) AS goods_ids, JSON_OBJECTAGG(goods_id, order_ref) AS order_map FROM aggregate_orders WHERE status = 0 GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id
